moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The iconic Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday today, August 16, continuing her reign as one of music's most influential artists.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Queen of Pop, Madonna! From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', she's still breaking boundaries. What's your ultimate Madonna track?

angles.name: Influence
angles.copy: 68 today! Madonna's impact on music, fashion, and culture is undeniable. Imagine the charts without her. Truly a legend.

moments.title: The Hundred Final today
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket competition culminates today, August 16, with both the Men's and Women's Finals being played at Lord's.

angles.name: Finals Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's Finals Day in The Hundred! Lord's is set for a blockbuster double-header with both the Men's and Women's trophies on the line. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Cricket Action
angles.copy: All eyes on Lord's today for The Hundred Finals. Fast-paced cricket, big hits, and two champions crowned by the end of the day. Don't miss it!

moments.title: UEFA Super Cup winner
moments.blurb: Aston Villa lifted the UEFA Super Cup on Wednesday, August 12, after defeating Champions League winners Paris Saint-Germain in Salzburg.

angles.name: Villa's Triumph
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Aston Villa, who are the new UEFA Super Cup champions! A massive win for the Premier League side on Wednesday. What a start to their season!

angles.name: European Glory
angles.copy: European silverware is already in the bag for Aston Villa! Their Super Cup victory against PSG is still being talked about. Who saw that coming?

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Premier League and EFL Championship seasons are in full swing, with matches continuing across the UK this weekend (August 16-17) and next.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: It's Week 2 of the Premier League season! Goals, drama, and talking points already. What's been the biggest surprise so far?

angles.name: EFL Action
angles.copy: The Championship is delivering the goods too! Great to have proper football back every weekend. Who's looking strong for promotion?

moments.title: All Points East returns
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival kicks off on August 21 and runs until August 30 at Victoria Park, featuring a diverse lineup including Tyler, The Creator and Lorde.

angles.name: London Festival
angles.copy: All Points East is just days away! Victoria Park is about to come alive for 10 days of incredible music from August 21st. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Lineup Buzz
angles.copy: From Tyler, The Creator to Lorde, All Points East has a massive lineup this year. Get ready for one of London's biggest summer music events starting Friday!

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa will celebrate her 31st birthday on Friday, August 22.

angles.name: Future Nostalgia Queen
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Dua Lipa turns 31 this Friday, August 22nd. What's your favourite track from the 'Future Nostalgia' queen?

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: The pop icon herself, Dua Lipa, celebrates her 31st birthday this week! From 'New Rules' to 'Houdini', she's consistently delivered hits. Send her some love!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival approaches
moments.blurb: The UK's iconic Reading and Leeds Festivals are set for August 27-30, bringing a huge lineup to Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park over the Bank Holiday weekend.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is just around the corner! The August Bank Holiday weekend is set for an explosion of music. Who's got their camping gear ready?

angles.name: Who's Playing?
angles.copy: From rock anthems to chart-toppers, Reading & Leeds has it all this year, starting August 27th. Which headliner are you most hyped for?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing buzz
moments.blurb: The full celebrity lineup for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 was completed on August 12, with professional dancer group routines set to be recorded on August 26 and 30 ahead of the September launch.

angles.name: Strictly Lineup Complete
angles.copy: The Strictly Come Dancing 2026 lineup is officially complete! Who are you most excited to see hit the dancefloor this year?

angles.name: Glitterball Season Ahead
angles.copy: The glitterball is calling! Strictly Come Dancing is gearing up for its return, with pro dance recordings happening later this month. Get ready for sequins and salsa!
